INSERT INTO wallet_balances (wallet_address, mint, ts, amount_raw, amount, price_usd, value_usd)
        SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
            $1::text[], $2::text[], $3::timestamptz[], $4::numeric[], $5::numeric[],
            $6::numeric[], $7::numeric[]
        )
        ON CONFLICT (wallet_address, mint, ts) DO NOTHING
